architecture_evidence.notes: Layer counts and tensor dimensions are grounded in the official config at the pinned commit; no separate official architecture diagram is asserted by this catalog entry.
architecture_evidence.uncertainty: Architecture graph is generated from config fields, not a manually traced paper figure.

metadata.notes: Public config.json fields; bf16 storage bytes are derived analytically.

model_assumptions: ordinary single-request Decode with fixed resident weights and dense attention
steady mean Token cost lies in a nonnegative affine context-growth envelope
ordinary OCP page-zero erases are bounded by serial service budgets; GC requires a closed empty-victim proof and complete placement/maintenance bounds, while block reuse remains excluded
after observed ordinary erases, a new steady-cost fit may exclude those already timed prefix cohorts and their cleanup; future erase guards remain unchanged
no unseen cache, scheduling, pressure-flush or allocation regime change
whole-Decode bounds include the exact timed prefix; a matched BF16 request uses directional HBF/HBM interval arithmetic with both single-point and ratio errors bounded by target
without a matched reference, per-storage conditional bounds retain target/(2+target) as a sufficient ratio condition
prefix holdout error does not establish full-suffix accuracy

metadata.known_values: 32 GB module capacity; DDR5-5600 grade; 64-bit payload width and 44.8 GB/s peak
analytical_assumptions: channel count unless separately cited by the preset
rank, bank, row and burst organization
burst interval is a payload scheduling budget, not measured tCCD
bank-group column/ACT/WRITE-to-READ timings and four-ACT window are unspecified (zero disables each constraint)
metadata.capacity_basis: declared capacity with an equivalent geometry rounded upward to whole rows
metadata.bandwidth_basis: explicit component one-way bandwidth; synthetic lane width does not infer pin speed
metadata.data_rate_basis: equivalent interface rate derived from declared aggregate bandwidth and synthetic width; not a measured pin speed
